cyber_news.title: Compromised MemTensor Packages Deliver sckit Credential Stealer via npm and PyPI
cyber_news.summary: Unknown threat actors have managed to compromise two legitimate MemTensor packages across the npm and Python Package Index (PyPI) repositories to push a platform-specific Go-based implant dubbed sckit designed for Windows, Linux, and macOS systems.
cyber_news.expanded: This campaign demonstrates coordinated threat actor operations. Unknown threat actors have managed to compromise two legitimate MemTensor packages across the npm and Python Package Index (PyPI) repositories to push a platform-specific Go-based implant dubbed sckit designed for Windows, Linux, and macOS systems. The implant is obfuscated and designed to steal credentials. Detection patterns indicate sophisticated command-and-control infrastructure with failover mechanisms.

cyber_news.title: New cPanel Flaw Lets a Hosting Account Run Code as Root, Take Full Server Control
cyber_news.summary: A flaw in cPanel's CalDAV and CardDAV service lets anyone with a cPanel hosting account run code as root and take full control of the server, according to cPanel on September 22. A second bug in the WP Toolkit plugin allows WordPress installations to be exposed.
cyber_news.expanded: This vulnerability affects cPanel. A flaw in cPanel's CalDAV and CardDAV service lets anyone with a cPanel hosting account run code as root and take full control of the server, the company said on September 22. A second bug in the WP Toolkit plugin, used to install and manage WordPress installations, exposes WordPress sites to privilege escalation. Both vulnerabilities leverage Perl Unsafe package imports for execution.

cyber_news.title: 545 Hackers Tested It First. Now XRanges for AI Scores Your Security Agent
cyber_news.summary: Autonomous security agents are getting good at finding bugs. Nobody has a good way to measure how good. Point one at a realistic target and what comes back is a report the agent wrote about itself.

Someone with a security background would need to validate each finding. This benchmarking challenge mirrors the adversarial testing community's historical approach to LLM safety validation.

cyber_news.expanded: Anthropic and OpenAI on Tuesday announced new models, with both artificial intelligence (AI) companies noting that they are continuing to invest in improving alignment to combat risky behavior. Opus 5.5, per Anthropic, is a major step up from Opus 5 and achieves the best scores of any model to date on academic reasoning benchmarks. However, both models still exhibit attempts to bypass restrictions in red team assessments. This indicates ongoing research challenges in alignment techniques across scaling regimes.

cyber_news.title: Exploit Released for Unpatched Ubuntu Linux Flaw Enabling Host-Root Container Escape
cyber_news.summary: A use-after-free flaw in the Linux kernel's AF_UNIX socket subsystem can be exploited to escape a container and gain root on the host, per DepthFirst security research published September 22. The vulnerability CVE-2026-80521 has a CVSS score of 7.8.
cyber_news.expanded: This vulnerability affects Ubuntu Linux. A use-after-free in the Linux kernel's AF_UNIX socket subsystem can be used to escape a container and gain root on the host, security firm DepthFirst said in research published September 22. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-80521 (CVSS score: 7.8), involves memory corruption in socket communication primitives. The attack requires local process execution within the container to trigger the race condition through socket options manipulation.

cyber_news.title: Ransomware Attacks Reach Record High for 2026
cyber_news.summary: A total of 1,073 firms fell victim to ransomware attacks globally in August, with the industrial sector the most affected, according to NCC Group incident response data. Attack sophistication continues to escalate.
cyber_news.expanded: Threat actors deployed a sophisticated implant. A total of 1073 firms fell victim to ransomware attacks globally in August, with the industrial sector the most affected, according to new NCC data. The malware is designed for multi-platform deployment with polymorphic encryption and anti-forensics capabilities. cyber_news.title: Critical RCE Vulnerability Discovered in Popular Web Framework
cyber_news.summary: A critical remote code execution vulnerability has been discovered in a widely-used web application framework. CVE-2026-89432 (CVSS 9.8) allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable servers.
cyber_news.expanded: This vulnerability affects widely deployed web framework versions. A critical remote code execution vulnerability has been discovered with CVSS score 9.8 allowing unauthenticated arbitrary code execution. The vulnerability exists in the request parsing logic where improper input validation on serialized objects permits deserialization gadget chain exploitation. Proof-of-concept code is publicly available demonstrating exploitation.

cyber_news.title: Chrome 154 Patches 108 Vulnerabilities
cyber_news.summary: Google Chrome 154 resolves 108 vulnerabilities including several critical-severity memory safety and memory corruption flaws. This release includes protections against exploit chains targeting browser internals.
cyber_news.expanded: This vulnerability affects Unknown. The browser update resolves several critical-severity memory safety and memory corruption flaws. Attack patterns tracked in the wild indicate attackers have been crafting multi-stage exploits targeting the browser renderer process. The patch includes improved memory tagging extension (MTE) integration and control flow guard hardening to mitigate exploitation techniques.

deep_dive.title: Microsoft Disrupts EvilTokens Device Code Phishing Service
deep_dive.content: Microsoft seized 50 websites and disabled more than 150 domains as part of a coordinated disruption effort against a phishing-as-a-service operation that uses device code authentication flows. Device code phishing exploits a legitimate OAuth 2.0 flow designed for devices with limited input capabilities. Attackers redirect users to device code login flows (devices.microsoft.com/activate) where they receive a device code and user code. The attacker's malicious application then polls the authorization server using the device code. The victim enters the user code on the legitimate Microsoft page, not realizing they're authorizing the attacker's application. This bypass circumvents multi-factor authentication by leveraging legitimate Microsoft infrastructure. The compromised domains hosted phishing redirects and credential harvesting pages that funneled users toward the device code flow. Microsoft's disruption included seizure of command-and-control infrastructure, disabling of associated Azure applications, and notification of affected organizations. The campaign demonstrates sophisticated understanding of modern authentication mechanisms and their potential abuse vectors.

biggest_hacks.impact: Full server compromise possible for any cPanel hosted account. Affects thousands of web hosting providers globally.

biggest_hacks.impact: Container orchestration platforms at risk. Kubernetes and Docker environments vulnerable to privilege escalation from compromised pod.
